Zakhmi parinda hai..
Phir bhi tu zinda hai..
Maanle kehna mera..
Tune into 'Tera Mera Rishta - New Version' from ‘Awarapan 2’. A heartfelt melody about love, hope, and never giving up, this beautiful track is recreated and rearranged by Mithoon. With lyrics by Sayeed Quadri and vocals by Saaj Bhatt and Subodhh Sharma, the original song is composed by Pritam and Mustafa Zahid. It features Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video.
The wait is finally over! Awarapan 2 is here. Book your tickets now:
Music recreated & rearranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
